name: What should I do immediately if I discover a PEX pipe leak in my home?

mainEntity.name: What should I do immediately if I discover a PEX pipe leak in my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you discover a PEX pipe leak, your immediate action should be to shut off the main water supply to your home to prevent further water damage. Locate your main shut-off valve, usually near your water meter or where the main line enters your house, and turn it off. Then, contact CG Plumbing Solutions promptly. This preparation will mitigate damage until our team arrives to assess and repair the leak, protecting your property in areas like Henderson or Summerlin.
acceptedAnswer.description: Immediately shut off your home's main water supply if you discover a PEX pipe leak, then call for professional repair.
